title: Malicious code in macs-shoaibs-pro17 (RubyGems)
description: The RubyGems package 'macs-shoaibs-pro17' version 90002.1 has been identified as malicious by the OpenSSF Package Analysis project. The package is considered malicious due to its communication with a domain linked to malicious activity. No CVSS score or detailed technical impact information is provided.
